posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif is reportedly planning her OTT debut and comeback after welcoming son Vihaan with Vicky Kaushal, actively reviewing streaming scripts for a return by late 2027.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali releases today (June 12) — the partition drama co-starring Naseeruddin Shah, Sharvari, and Vedang Raina also features an AR Rahman soundtrack.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser crosses 75 million views in 24 hours as Alia's YRF Spy Universe debut generates massive buzz. The film releases July 3 with Bobby Deol and Anil Kapoor.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka ranks #3 on Fortune India's inaugural Most Valuable Celebrities list — the only woman in the top three — while continuing to shoot SS Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's King confirmed for Christmas 2026 release with a ₹350 crore budget — the action thriller directed by Siddharth Anand co-stars daughter Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film, their first on-screen pairing since the blockbuster Bajrangi Bhaijaan over a decade ago.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor is in talks to play the female lead opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock's Mahavatar, a grand mythological drama about Lord Parashurama expected to go on floors soon.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announces her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh while juggling two blockbusters — she's using a body double for action in Atlee's Raka and recently shot combat scenes for King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar TV premiere shatters records as the highest-reach movie premiere in five years, while Dhurandhar 2 becomes the most-watched Indian film on OTT with 70M+ views.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: A 23-year-old dance clip of Aishwarya from the never-released film Radheshyam Sitaram has gone viral on social media, while fans await her next project with Mani Ratnam.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 trailer with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon tops YouTube charts for a full week ahead of its June 19 release, while Rashmika also gears up for Rana Baali with Vijay Deverakonda.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram releases June 19 — a Baasha-style action-comedy where she plays a newlywed hiding an action-packed past. She also co-produced the film under her own banner.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's next film Raaka with director Atlee officially announced — Deepika Padukone joins the cast as the VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle aims for a massive pan-India release.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi crosses ₹150 crore net in just 4 days and ₹200 crore gross by Day 5 — the sports drama is now the 8th best-selling Telugu film on BookMyShow.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: War 2 with Hrithik Roshan and Kiara Advani confirmed for IMAX release on August 14, while Jr NTR's Dragon with Prashanth Neel has been pushed to June 2027 for VFX work.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi earned ₹8 crore for Peddi — her career-highest paycheck — amid a heated debate over objectification in the film. She's next in Atlee's Raaka with Allu Arjun.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday stars alongside Lakshya in Dharma's musical romance Chand Mera Dil and returns as the lead in Call Me Bae Season 2 on Prime Video's stacked 2026 slate.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani stars alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in War 2, confirmed for IMAX release on August 14 — one of the most anticipated Bollywood films of the year.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik signs with Anonymous Content, the Hollywood powerhouse behind The Revenant and Spotlight, signaling a potential international career move alongside his Krrish 4 prep.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with David Dhawan navigates a crowded June release window, competing with Yash's Toxic and a slate of major summer blockbusters.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's All Hearts Tour continues across international venues in 2026, following her iconic IPL 2025 opening ceremony with an 80-piece choir at Eden Gardens, Kolkata.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman scores two major releases this week — Main Vaapas Aaunga (June 12) with Diljit Dosanjh and Imtiaz Ali, plus the Chikiri Chikiri track from Ram Charan's box office hit Peddi.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay is now Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu after his TVK party's stunning election victory — senior leaders from DMK and AIADMK continue defecting to his camp.
